name: Grimey’s American Trash Tour, Day 1 — Perdido Key -> Dauphin Island
desc: Good lord. Day one, here we go. Go to the drop off from Atlanta at 4:00. Last ferry for Dauphin Island was 7:15. 33 miles in three hours with all that weight, plus some heavy sea breeze. GOODNIGHT, SEE YOU SOON LA

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 2 — (55 miles) Dauphin Island, AL -> Gautier, MI
desc: Boy am I tired! Worked my first full work day on top of biking. Strava lost my morning ride, so missing 25 miles from Dauphin Island -> Bayou La Batre

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 3 — Gautier, MI -> Bay Saint Louis, MI
desc: First flat tire! And the back one, so I had to remove the entire rig to be able to get to it easily. Thank goodness for the shade of the palm trees behind the Regions bank in Ocean Springs. Refueled at the Burger King and pressed on 36 miles to Bay Saint Louis. It was boardwalk/beach view almost the entire way. Strong headwinds

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 4 — Bay Saint Louis, MI -> New Orleans, LA
desc: Wild ride. Tell you about it later.

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 5 — New Orleans -> La Place (lol)
desc: Big day. First day with SPD cleats, only fell once, and honestly—I had it coming. Shitty ride from my motel to Bourbon Street MOSTLY because the Danziger Bridge was too narrow to bike, so I had to walk what felt like half an hour. Sat outside of Jackson Square and helped Grimey put on his makeup, where we met our new good friends from Illinois

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 6
Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 7 (81 mi) — Convent, LA -> Ventress, LA
desc: BIG DAY! Strava fell asleep and missed some miles but we did EIGHTY MILES TODAY. Today wasn’t the most enjoyable ride, but we RODE it! Came through Baton Rouge just as everyone was pouring in for the LSU game. Roads sucked in Baton Rouge—really slowed me down. Before and after Baton Rouge was ALL sugarcane fields. Beautiful, 4real.

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 9 (half rest day) - Bunkie, LA -> Ville Platte, LA
desc: Easy day. Worked from McDonalds, picked up my laundry from firemen, Trent and Danny, then biked 25 miles to a Best Western. Monday’s will be my hotel nights. For now, we’re allowed two of those a week.

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 10 - Ville Platte, LA -> Fenton, LA
desc: Melatonin is kicking in rn lol. I went FAST today. Not sure if it was the wind or me. Fun though. Feel good about today. Will share more later.

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 11 - Fenton, LA -> Vinton, LA
Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 12 - Vinton, LA -> Vidor, TX
desc: Low spirits the first half of the day! Therapy with a motel room!

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 13 - Vidor, TX -> Thicket, TX
desc: Biked 55 miles without stopping. Sleeping in a beauty shop in the middle of nowhere. Lol

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 14 - Thistle, TX -> Montgomery, TX
desc: Sleeping in a park tonight RIP

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 15 - Montgomery, TX -> Navasota, TX
desc: Rain didn’t let me go far today…

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 16 - Navasota, TX -> Burton, TX
desc: Bike seat broke two miles in. Big lol, had to fix that. Put me two hours behind. Crushed a chocky protein shake at a circle k halfway through and ended up and the most beautiful campground yet. COVERED in I mean like millions of nats. Like little lake critters. They left for the most part, thank God. Shout out to Cless for pointing out the ant

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 16 - Yegua Creek Park, TX -> Beuscher State Park, TX
desc: EASY DAY. Long week day, lots of hills, but I feel my legs getting stronger 💪

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 17 - Buescher State Park. TX -> Austin, TX
Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 20 - Dripping Springs, TX -> Fredericksburg, TX
desc: We are in HILL country now!!

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 21 - Fredericksburg, TX -> Vanderpool, TX
desc: Hardest day yet holy hell those hills rocked me AND the wind honestly mostly the wind I am BEAT

name: Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 29 - Sanderson, TX -> Alpine, TX
Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 36
Grimey’s Great American Trash Tour, Day 45 - Goodyear, AZ -> Salome, AZ
